properties.name: Perseverance recorded rover traverse (PLACES best_interp)
properties.convention: Display GeoJSON: east-positive longitude 0-360 (all < 180 E, no wrap applied) and planetocentric latitude copied from PLACES best_interp.csv v16.0; coordinates copied from source, not recomputed. Web Mercator interprets display latitude as geodetic; the planetocentric/geodetic distinction at Jezero is ~0.1-0.2 deg, so alignment against any georeferenced basemap is pending the SIS (PPPCS) ellipsoid review documented in the region display transform. The product's planetodetic_latitude column is defective (constant value in release 16) and was not used.
properties.limitations: Recorded rover traverse; not an astronaut route and not terrain-safety evidence. Display-grade pending basemap-alignment review, not survey-grade. Localization accuracy per the Rover PLACES SIS. Display decimation thins vertices to ~10 m spacing.
